metric: share of messages routed to the expected intent, per phrasing slice (deterministic rules in app/domain/intents.py)
note: Rules-only accepted baseline (CI-safe, no LLM). A slice may improve; it must not get worse. The rules alone leave typos and Hinglish at 0; the gated LLM fallback (ADR-015) closes the gap, see parity_intent_hybrid_live.json.
